run.binary_metric_definition: Labels 1 and 2 are relevant; label 0 is not relevant.
run.graded_metric_definition: nDCG uses gains 2^label - 1 for labels 0, 1, and 2.
run.recall_definition: Recall denominators contain relevant candidates in the pooled top-20 union, not the full corpus.
run.human_validation: One project member reviewed all 791 pairs and confirmed the labels.
